name: fastsearch-mcp
description: Lightning-fast file search for Claude Desktop & Web apps via direct NTFS Master File Table access. Zero indexing, zero caching, sub-second search across millions of files.

direct_mft_access.note: Direct NTFS MFT reads, no background indexing

standalone_mode.note: Interactive terminal server mode without SCM setup

dedicated_search_page.note: SOTA React UI with live status, filters, and preview drawer

direct_rest_api.note: FastAPI REST API bridge on port 10845
